HOME SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.

   B. A mixture of two liquids

   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)

   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)
